messages:
kevin: quick UX question  where should the org/project scope switch live on narrow screens? current prototype has it as a horizontal chip row above the chart and it wraps weirdly. prototype: https://figma.com/file/scope-proto
anya: wrap is the problem. on mobile it eats vertical space and pushes charts down. prefer collapsing it into a single compact control (dropdown or menu) with a visible breadcrumb showing current scope.
rachel: dropdown works. if we show a breadcrumb like 'Org: AcmeCorp' that keeps context without the full chip list. clicking it opens a menu with project list.
kevin: good. what about keyboard/voice access? must be reachable and announce scope changes.
devin: implement menu as a button with aria-haspopup="menu" and update aria-live region on change: `aria-live=polite` announcing "Scope changed to Project X".
anya: also add a short help tooltip: "Switch to project to see per-project breakdowns" (visible on hover/focus). keeps PMs happy.achel: invoice CTA ambiguity again: support reported customers clicking Download and expecting CSV. change to two explicit CTAs: primary "Download invoice (PDF)" and link "Export ledger (CSV)". keep helper text: "PDFs are per-month; CSV is line-item ledger."
kevin: agreed. also for bulk exports we should show estimate: "This export contains 24 invoices (~120MB). Large exports will be queued and emailed."
devin: note on implementation  backend only supports month-bucketed PDFs. If UI allows arbitrary ranges we should either snap to months or show a warning: "PDFs generated per month; non-month ranges will be split."
anya: accessibility nit: legend swatches are not keyboard-focusable in current design. we need them to be toggles (checkboxes) with aria-checked and visible focus ring.achel: +1. also ensure color+pattern for series identification for colorblind users. add pattern overlay option in legend panel.
kevin: copy idea: instead of "Show legend" button label use "Legend & visibility" (short). open to alternatives.
anya: I like "Legend & visibility". developer-friendly and signals controls.
ops-bot: Prototype updated: https://figma.com/file/abcd_scope_updated  @kevin pinned the frame.
devin: i'll break into tickets: mobile scope menu, breadcrumb, invoice CTAs + export estimate, legend a11y (focus & patterns), and backend note to snap PDFs to months.achel: will run a quick keyboard navigation pass once dev build is ready. No blockers from design side.
kevin: thanks all, moving to backlog. :shipit:
